title: Day 2 — Public Traces
_comment: Ghostscan day (#44). 'rules' is omitted deliberately: the rulebook is campaign-wide and inherited from day_01.json with this day's Overseer-Variable flips applied. An authored day carries only what is DIFFERENT about it.
_comment_script: Slot 0 is the fast-admit lesson (elite org, sweep confirms, no hours spent). 1 teaches the commit-email compare, 3 the breach corpus, 5 the faked affiliation. 2 and 4 are unscripted so the day is not wall-to-wall violations.

rule_sheet.summary: Ghostscan is live. Yesterday's dossier rules still stand; today you can also check whether the person on the form exists in public.

affiliations: — a trusted organisation can never be faked. If they claim one, the sweep will confirm it. Admit and move on.
an organisation the sweep shows differently — that is AFFILIATION_MISMATCH, a deny

notes: An email in a breach corpus is a deny. The corpora are on the right-hand panel; they never change, so learn them.
A commit email that differs from the dossier email is a deny.
Profiles that exist but list no organisation, or a handle that barely appears at all — flag, don't deny.
